notes: Screen 06 is Book Step Six (Career Events). Career Length stays on Screen 05; the book gives it no effect here beyond flavour for Novice.
The book's d20 roll is not offered; the player chooses both events.
Prototype: the two events must be different (the book does not say).

An event's focus can be one of its book examples, any focus from the Focus Probability Matrix (p.85-88), or the player's own. Events with no examples (Death of a Friend, Lauded by Another Culture) offer the matrix and custom only.
The book applies attribute (12) and discipline (5) limits at Step Seven, so no limits are checked here.
Art for each event is eventArtPattern with {id} replaced by the event id. Missing files fall back to the placeholder portrait.
